name: Cauldron of Sin'dorei Flasks
tooltip:
Cauldron of Sin'dorei Flasks
Item Level 58
Binds to Warband
Use: Place a cauldron that allows party and raid members to take flasks of their choosing from among the recipes known by your Warband. Only alchemists with the cauldron recipe will contribute.

The cauldron lasts for 5 min and has 40 charges.
Requires Level 81
Max Stack: 200
Sell Price: 15
